name: buddy-revival
description: Bring back Claude Code's Buddy: your original companion, re-derived from your account, living above your prompt

compact.title: Compact mode
compact.description: Show the buddy as a one-line status entry instead of the animated band

llmQuips.title: LLM reactions
llmQuips.description: Generate buddy reactions with a small model call (costs tokens); off = canned lines

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Master switch for the chirp (macOS; silent elsewhere)

chirpAfterTurn.title: Chirp when a turn finishes
chirpAfterTurn.description: Chirp when a turn longer than this finishes

chirpOnPermission.title: Chirp on permission asks
chirpOnPermission.description: Chirp when Claude needs your permission to continue

chirpWhenWaiting.title: Chirp when Claude is waiting
chirpWhenWaiting.description: Chirp on Claude Code's 'waiting for your input' notice (sent while the window is in the background)

chirpOncePerWait.title: Chirp once per wait
chirpOncePerWait.description: After one chirp, stay quiet until you send the next prompt (permission asks excepted)
